pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.dxc5
pages.notes: Overview had the isolated pawn on the wrong side (White space, Black blockading); plan 2 had a d4-d5 push with no White d-pawn. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.Ngf3 Nc6
pages.notes: Overview gave White the isolated pawn (the main line leaves it with Black after 5.exd5 exd5 6.Bb5 Bd6 7.dxc5 Bxc5); plan 3 had a d4-d5 push. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.Ngf3 Nf6
pages.notes: Overview gave White the isolated pawn; plan 1 had a d4-d5 push; plan 3 had the exchange logic reversed. Rewrote overview and all four plans around the main line to 9...Nxc5.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.Ngf3 cxd4 6.Bc4 Qd6
pages.notes: Overview and plans described an isolated d4-pawn for White and a d4-d5 break; after the main line White regains d4 with the knight and there is no isolated pawn. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.exd5 Qxd5, Main Line, 10.Nxd4 a6 11.c3
pages.notes: Overview and plans described an isolated d4-pawn, a d5 push and blockade on d5, with no White d-pawn on the board. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.exd5 Qxd5, Main Line, 10.Nxd4 a6 11.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an e5-push with no White e-pawn; plan 2 called ...Qc7 an unpin. Rewrote both plans (first plan 2 rewrite gave a wrong reason for ...Qc7, reviewer rejected, reworded and re-accepted).

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Open System
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a d5-d4 push blocked by White's pawn; plan 3 wrote 0-0 and plan 4 Black moves without ellipses, so they read as White moves, and plan 4 claimed an open c-file. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.exd5 exd5 5.Ngf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...d5-d4 push blocked by White's pawn. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Open System, Advance Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black controlling c5 (no piece can go there); plan 1 used d4 as a White outpost with White's own pawn on it. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Open, 4.exd5 exd5 5.Ngf3 a6 6.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...a6 stopping Nb5 (the point is to keep the bishop off b5); plan 2 claimed an open c-file; plan 1 blockaded on d4 with White's pawn there. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.
